group_trips.title: Georgia Highlands, Kazbegi and Kakheti Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A six-night escorted group trip combining Tbilisi, Mtskheta, the Kazbegi mountains and the Kakheti wine region.
group_trips.overview:
This escorted journey takes you through the heart of Georgia in a small group, led by a trip captain from arrival to departure. You begin in Tbilisi and nearby Mtskheta, then climb the Georgian Military Highway to Kazbegi, where the Gergeti Trinity Church sits beneath the Caucasus peaks.

Back in Tbilisi, a day in the Kakheti wine region brings Bodbe Monastery, the hilltop town of Sighnaghi and a winery visit. A free day in the capital leaves time for cafes, markets and last-minute shopping before the flight home.
highlights: Guided Tbilisi tour with the cable car to Narikala Fortress
Mtskheta, with Jvari Monastery and Svetitskhoveli Cathedral
Georgian Military Highway with Ananuri Fortress and Gudauri
A night in Kazbegi (Stepantsminda) beneath the Caucasus peaks
Gergeti Trinity Church and the Georgia-Russia Friendship Monument

group_trips.title: Georgia Wine Country and Batumi Black Sea Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A seven-night escorted group trip from Tbilisi and the Kakheti vineyards to the Black Sea resort of Batumi.
group_trips.overview:
This group trip pairs Georgia's capital and wine country with its sunny Black Sea coast. You start in Tbilisi with its old town and nearby Mtskheta, then head east to the Kakheti vineyards, Bodbe Monastery and Sighnaghi.

A scenic drive across western Georgia brings you to Batumi, where you have three nights to enjoy the seafront boulevard, the Alphabetic Tower, the botanical garden and the ancient fortress at Gonio. A trip captain travels with the group, and you return to Tbilisi by road before flying home.

group_trips.title: Georgia Weekend Escape: Tbilisi, Mtskheta and Kazbegi
group_trips.summary: A three-night long-weekend escape to Georgia: Tbilisi's old town, ancient Mtskheta and a day in the Kazbegi mountains, with a trip captain and Friday departures.
group_trips.overview:
This short escorted break packs the best of Georgia into a long weekend without rushing. You stay three nights in Tbilisi, so there is no packing and unpacking, and head out from the capital each day with a trip captain and a small group.

One day covers the old town, the Bridge of Peace and the cable car up to Narikala Fortress, followed by an afternoon in Mtskheta with Jvari Monastery and Svetitskhoveli Cathedral. The next takes the Georgian Military Highway to Ananuri Fortress, Gudauri and the Gergeti Trinity Church beneath the Caucasus peaks, with time left on the last morning for a cafe breakfast and some shopping.

honeymoon_trips.title: Georgia Honeymoon: Old Tbilisi, Kazbegi Peaks and Kakheti Wine Country
honeymoon_trips.summary: A private six-night honeymoon in Georgia: candlelit evenings in Tbilisi, two nights beneath the Caucasus peaks at Kazbegi and a vineyard stay in Sighnaghi, with private transfers throughout.
honeymoon_trips.overview:
This private honeymoon is paced for two. You begin in Tbilisi, where wooden balconies, hillside churches and the cable car up to Narikala Fortress make a gentle introduction, and where you will have a candlelit dinner to mark the start of married life.

Then the road climbs the Georgian Military Highway to Kazbegi, with a stop at Mtskheta on the way. Two nights beneath the Caucasus peaks give you time for a private 4x4 drive up to the Gergeti Trinity Church, long mountain walks if you wish, and slow evenings with a view. You return to Tbilisi for a relaxed day and a couples spa session.

The finale is Kakheti, Georgia's wine country. You stay a night in the hilltop town of Sighnaghi, known as the City of Love, with a private tasting among the vineyards of the Alazani Valley. Your car and guide are exclusively yours, and every day has one main experience, so there is no rushing.

Check in to your hotel in Sighnaghi and spend a slow evening together.
Overnight stay in Sighnaghi.

itinerary.title: Departure from Georgia
itinerary.description:
After a relaxed breakfast, check out of your hotel.
Use the free morning for a last walk through Sighnaghi.
Drive by private car to Tbilisi International Airport in time for your flight, which takes around two hours.
Depart Georgia with wonderful memories.
